heads.la: PROLOGUS. Animalium et rotarum litteralis explicatio.
heads.en: PROLOGUE. A literal explanation of the living creatures and of the wheels.

heads.la: CAPUT PRIMUM. Compendiosa comprehensio eorum aedificiorum quae ad unam medietatem pertinent.
heads.en: CHAPTER THE FIRST. A summary comprehension of those buildings which belong to the one half.

heads.la: CAPUT II. Compendiosa praelibatio eorum aedificiorum quae ad aliam medietatem pertinent.
heads.en: CHAPTER II. A summary foretaste of those buildings which belong to the other half.

heads.la: CAPUT III Quomodo, vel quam multis circumstantiis mystica haec descriptio commendetur.
heads.en: CHAPTER III In what manner, and by how many circumstances, this mystical description is commended.

heads.la: CAPUT IV. Collectis hinc inde Scripturae testimoniis, hoc hic de una porticu astruitur quod de caeteris omnibus jure intelligatur.
heads.en: CHAPTER IV. The testimonies of Scripture being gathered from this side and that, that is here established concerning one portico which may rightly be understood of all the rest.

heads.la: CAPUT V. De his quae ad unam medietatem cujuslibet porticus pertinere videntur.
heads.en: CHAPTER V. On those things which seem to pertain to one half of any portico whatever.

heads.la: CAPUT VI. De caeteris quae de porticu restant, ad totius descriptionis completionem.
heads.en: CHAPTER VI. On the remaining things concerning the portico, for the completion of the whole description.

heads.la: CAPUT VII. Expositio litterae super descriptionem orientalis portae.
heads.en: CHAPTER VII. Exposition of the letter upon the description of the eastern gate.

heads.la: CAPUT VIII. De his quae pertinent ad descriptionem totius.
heads.en: CHAPTER VIII. On those things which pertain to the description of the whole.

heads.la: CAPUT IX. De aquilonari et australi porticu exterioris atrii.
heads.en: CHAPTER IX. On the northern and southern portico of the outer court.

heads.la: CAPUT X. De tribus porticibus interioris atrii.
heads.en: CHAPTER X. On the three porticoes of the inner court.

heads.la: CAPUT XI. De mensis ubi immolabatur holocaustum, et de gazophylaciis cantorum.
heads.en: CHAPTER XI. On the tables where the holocaust was sacrificed, and on the chambers of the singers.

heads.la: CAPUT XII. De coquinis quae subter porticus fabricatae erant et de atrio interiori.
heads.en: CHAPTER XII. On the kitchens which were built beneath the porticoes, and on the inner court.

heads.la: CAPUT XIII. De quantitate vel aedificiorum quae templo adjacebant.
heads.en: CHAPTER XIII. On the size or of the buildings which lay adjacent to the temple.

heads.la: CAPUT XIV. De situ vel ratione caeterorum aedificiorum quae ad occidentalem plagam erant.
heads.en: CHAPTER XIV. On the site or the plan of the remaining buildings which were toward the western quarter.

heads.la: CAPUT XV Quomodo, vel unde colligitur quae sit arduitas montis.
heads.en: CHAPTER XV How, or from what, it is gathered what the steepness of the mountain is.

heads.la: CAPUT XVI. Descriptio templi ipsiusque vestibuli.
heads.en: CHAPTER XVI. A description of the temple and of its porch.

heads.la: CAPUT XVII. Descriptio aedificiorum quae templo adjacebant.
heads.en: CHAPTER XVII. A description of the buildings which lay next to the temple.

heads.la: CAPUT XVIII. De caeteris quae restant usque ad finem descriptionis.
heads.en: CHAPTER XVIII. On the other things which remain, unto the end of the description.

heads.la: CAPUT XIX. De descriptione altaris holocausti.
heads.en: CHAPTER XIX. On the description of the altar of holocaust.

heads.la: CAPUT XX. Terrae promissionis descriptio seu divisio, et quae portio debeatur sacerdotibus, et quae levitis.
heads.en: CHAPTER XX. A description or division of the land of promise, and what portion is owed to the priests, and what to the Levites.

headnotes.en: This is what is said there
